Description
This parameter enables/disables the Development Error Detection and Notification.
true: Development error detection is enabled. false: Development error detection is
disabled.
Note: In general, the development error detection is recommended during pre-test
phase. It is not recommended to enable the development error detection in production
code due to increased runtime and ROM needs.
Tags: atp.Status=draft
